primary_source_check.finding: The paper states that 23 observations were collected but publishes them only in Figure 2. Nineteen distinct marker centers are visually separable and bundled; four measurements overlap too closely to recover independently. The molar V0 was converted to the Z=4 conventional cell for the EOS record.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from the EOS discussion (p. 498). The 23 observations are published only in Figure 2; nineteen marker centers are separable and digitized.

primary_data_check.finding: The compression series is published only in Figure 2. Nineteen distinct marker centers are separable and bundled with digitization uncertainty; the paper states that 23 total observations were collected, so four overlapping observations cannot be recovered independently from the plot. No experimental error bars are plotted.
